name: Lynn
source:
Human class.
An extremely strong girl who's able to take on a wild boar with her bare hands.
She has trouble controlling her power—her vise-grip handshake has resulted in many broken bones.
Lynn doesn't dwell on her mistakes and tries to forget them as soon as possible, which often leads her to make the same mistakes again.
However, her classmates still love her for her energetic and friendly nature.
